title: PORTER PACK
credit_text: This work is compilation of the following: 1. "Switch on" of the Portapak including momentary physical manipulation of the tape over the record head, producing breakup in the image. (This image is later photographed from the screen to be used to illustrate the article "Interference", written for the Studio International Video issue.) Title of the compilation follows, then a sequence walking outside the house into the exterior garden, viewing the Portapak on the artist's shoulder, before returning to the interior, where the camera is mounted on a tripod and lined up on a radio standing on the table. 2. "Radio" 3. "Objects" 4. Statements and "chat": the artist describes the editing strategy employed in this tape, including the incorporation of an informal "chat" recorded some weeks previously. (This material is later revisited in Image Con Text: Two (1984), in the 8mm film sequence.) 5. "Haircut" 6. Intro to: 7. "Cow" 8. "Cat" 9. "Switch off": the Portapak deck is seen as the artist's hand comes in to switch to Off.
